nearMisses.notes: Ideally, if the two creatures require different amounts of mana, you will want to start the combo with the lower cost creature in your hand. This should negate the need to start with mana. However, the opposite can be done if you provide mana (as needed) to cover the difference. An example of the prerequisite: If the creatures have total cost {3}{U}{U}, other creatures you control, after tapping two times each, must produce at least {3}{U}{U}. Therefore, if creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, they will create {4}{U}{U} after being tapped twice, and meet the prerequisite.

prerequisites.notable: Wanderwine Prophets does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.

nearMisses.steps:
Declare Wanderwine Prophets as an attacker.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Merfolk token and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

prerequisites.notable: You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.

nearMisses.steps:
During your cleanup step, discard down to your maximum hand size.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each card discarded this way.
When the Zombie(s) enter the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers that many times, causing you to draw that many cards.
Discard down to your maximum hand size, as you are still in your cleanup step.
Repeat from step 2.
